newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's STET, RAI plan strategic alliance.
newsitem.headline: Italy's STET, RAI plan strategic alliance.

text.p: Italy's state broadcaster RAI and state telecoms holding STET said they planned a strategic alliance to develop a common digital standard for satellite and cable communications in Italy.
The companies said in a joint statement they would also seek accords with Italian electronics companies on decoders.
The agreement aimed to create a "digital platform, open to all multimedia editors in order to guarantee a broader development of the industry," they said.
If this was not possible, they aimed to create an autonomous digital platform which would act as national "common carrier".
The alliance aimed at "securing a national presence in this sector that is able to integrate in the globalization of the industry," they said.
They intended to boost the amount of Italian-language programmes for foreign markets, including interactive multimedia, and to develop digital television programming within the Italian market.
